email.subject: Re: Final interview - Machine Learning Engineer
email.body:
Hi,

Thanks for coming in for the final interview last week. Everyone you met was impressed, and I'm thrilled to offer you the Machine Learning Engineer position at Nimbus Forge. The offer letter with salary and benefits is attached.

Take a few days to look it over, and call me if you'd like to talk anything through.

Best,
Jonas

On Mon, 12 Oct 2026 at 09:14, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@nimbusforge.example.com> wrote:
> Hi, we'd like to invite you to the final interview on Thursday 15 October at 14:00
> at our office. Please confirm the time works for you.
